name: Jody Mehta
life: “I still remember mending a pair of spectacles with fishing line.” On Tuesday, near the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio, Jody notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I know that bent temple. I repaired it for my former partner after we split up.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a pale blue work shirt and a printed handkerchief folded into the pocket. Jody has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape. Jody rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket during a conversation.
personality: Jody enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Jody is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To identify the old repair without involving the former partner unnecessarily.
family: Amanda Kerr is Jody’s half-sibling. Jody makes the call. Amanda is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The engine lullaby*, Amanda says, “I sang against the hum to steady my voice for an audition.”
connections: Geraldine Quintero. The temple repair identifies the frame and the note in its case.

reactions.situation: The counter is busy and another visitor starts to hurry the signing
reactions.response: Jody puts a time on when the counter will be free again and protects the witness's time to read.

reactions.situation: A family supper turns into an argument about old debt
reactions.response: Jody separates the money question from the broken promise and asks which one the family wants to discuss first.
